brief:
Francesca Albanese, the United Nations special rapporteur on the occupied Palestinian territories, accused Israeli forces and settlers of maintaining a siege on the town of Qasra south of Nablus and cutting off its water supply, Shehab Wire reported. She characterized the actions as part of an ongoing escalation targeting residents of the community.

The allegations emerge as Qasra faces systematic pressure through military blockade and resource deprivation. Albanese's statement reflects mounting international concern over conditions in Palestinian towns under Israeli military control, where access to essential services remains restricted.
